text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a lightweight shim rollout for the SDK client today, non-blocking but want hands on deck for smoke/rollback.
maya: SGTM. What time window are we thinking?
alex: aiming for 14:30 PT -> 15:00 PT canary, then 15:30 PT gradual ramp if all green.
chen: I can run the deploy at 14:30. Will push the shim tag `shim/v1.0.3` to the gateway pool.
lina: I'll own smoke tests and client sanity after canary. Quick checklist: 1) basic generate, 2) embeddings, 3) auth sanity.
sam: I'll be on-call for rollback and routing fallback. What's the rollback command? :thinking_face:
alex: rollback is `infractl deploy rollback --service=client-adapter --to-tag=stable` — needs infra write.
chen: noted. I'll keep a terminal open and the previous tag `stable` pinned.
maya: Are we doing any client-facing comms or is this internal only? We had a couple partners on older adapter bindings.
alex: internal first. If canary looks good, we'll send a short partner note: "minor client shim deployed; no action required". @maya can you draft the blurb?
maya: Yep — will post to #product-partners after ramp.
lina: Smoke script (quick):

```
# smoke.sh
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate | jq .choices
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" \ 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .data
```

lina: I'll run that against the canary bucket and paste results here.
chen: Can we confirm client backward-compat behavior? shim should accept both old `messages` and new `content` key.
alex: yes — shim maps `messages -> content` internally. Unit tests added in client-adapter repo.
maya: Quick QA question: are flags off by default? We don't want accidental enable for prod customers.
chen: feature flag `client_shim_rollout` is OFF for prod, ON in canary bucket only.
sam: Great. If rollback needed, I'll flip the flag back to OFF and trigger deploy rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by chen at 1737006600. Status: queued :gear:
lina: First smoke pass (14:40 PT): generate OK, embeddings OK, auth headers validated. sample: `{\"text\":\"hello world\"}`
alex: Nice. Can we keep 10-minute canary before ramp? If Lina sees no regressions, proceed to ramp at 15:00 PT.
maya: Drafted partner note, short + link to changelog. Posting to #product-partners after ramp.
chen: Starting canary now — pushing `shim/v1.0.3` to canary pool.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by chen at 1737004565. Canary: 5 instances.
lina: Monitoring traces — latency within expected bounds, no error spike.
sam: Standby for rollback window until 15:10 PT. If anything >0.5% 5xx, we rollback.
alex: Agreed. Also ensure telemetry sampling on this bucket is 100% for 30m so we catch subtle regressions.
chen: telemetry sampling set.
lina: 14:55 PT final canary check: all clear. No regressions on the smoke suite.
alex: ramping to 30% at 15:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete at 1737005400. Status: running.
maya: Posting partner note now. Will include rollback instructions and contact list.
sam: Keep me in the thread for immediate pings. I'll action rollback if needed.
chen: Ramp to 100% starting 15:20 PT if no issues.
lina: I'll re-run smoke after 30% ramp.
alex: Thanks everyone — summary: chen deploys, lina smoke, maya partner comms, sam rollback owner. If anything happens ping @sam and call outage channel.
maya: :thumbsup:
lina: all good from my side.
sam: Ready.
alex: Closing this thread and will update post-mortem doc if anything comes up. :white_check_mark:
